item.title: Non-ideal communication and the architecture of the common ground (NICTACG)
item.description: April 24-25, 2027 UMass Linguistics department, Room N400 Integrative Learning Center, 650 N Pleasant St, Amherst, MA 01003 In recent years, the “social” turn in philosophy of language has generated a growing body of work that challenges the standard Gricean–Stalnakerian picture of communication and its understanding of the common ground. This literature questions the view of conversational context as a single, shared body of information (e.g., Camp 2018; Harris 2020; Berstler 2025; Simons 2025).
